<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><BR>
S&amp;P Global Evolves&nbsp;Market Intelligence&nbsp;Operating Model&nbsp;</B>&nbsp;<BR>
<B>to&nbsp;Accelerate&nbsp;Agentic Solutions,&nbsp;Platform&nbsp;Capabilities&nbsp;and&nbsp;Innovation;&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>Announces Executive Leadership Changes</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">NEW YORK (July 6, 2026) &mdash;&nbsp;S&amp;P Global (NYSE: SPGI) today
announced the&nbsp;new&nbsp;Market Intelligence&nbsp;operating model.&nbsp;This evolution is designed&nbsp;to better align the business&nbsp;with&nbsp;changing
customer needs and&nbsp;to&nbsp;position the company for growth in an AI-driven&nbsp;market,&nbsp;pairing&nbsp;its&nbsp;unmatched breadth
and depth of data and deep domain&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;with more integrated AI-powered tools,&nbsp;workflows&nbsp;and experiences.&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;<BR>
<B>S&amp;P Global Market Intelligence&nbsp;</B>will be organized into two focused verticals with distinct but complementary&nbsp;areas,&nbsp;<B>Kensho&nbsp;Data&nbsp;&amp;
Platforms</B>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<B>Enterprise Solutions</B>, enabling a streamlined and unified approach to help customers move from insight
to action with speed and confidence.&nbsp;Together, these verticals bring S&amp;P Global&nbsp;Market Intelligence&nbsp;data, AI,&nbsp;software&nbsp;and
workflow capabilities into strong alignment with quickly evolving customer needs.&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Kensho Data &amp; Platforms</B>&nbsp;will be led by&nbsp;<B>Sally
Moore</B>, whose role as&nbsp;<B>Chief Client Officer</B>&nbsp;is expanding to include<B>&nbsp;Co-Head&nbsp;of&nbsp;Market Intelligence,&nbsp;Kensho
Data &amp; Platforms</B>. The vertical will bring together data&nbsp;delivery, platform&nbsp;capabilities&nbsp;and client engagement to
create an&nbsp;AI-led&nbsp;customer&nbsp;experience.&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Kensho&nbsp;Data&nbsp;will be the client-facing data&nbsp;product&nbsp;and
AI delivery layer for Market Intelligence.&nbsp;As an embedded, innovation-led capability, Kensho&nbsp;Data&nbsp;helps S&amp;P Global
unlock more value from its trusted data, enabling new&nbsp;products and capabilities that deliver greater impact&nbsp;for&nbsp;customers.&#8239;Kensho&nbsp;Data&nbsp;is
led by&nbsp;<B>Bhavesh Dayalji</B>, in a new role as&nbsp;Head of Kensho Data&nbsp;&amp;&nbsp;Intelligence.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Platforms&nbsp;will&nbsp;bring together&nbsp;world-class&nbsp;client&nbsp;interfaces,&nbsp;including&nbsp;Capital
IQ,&nbsp;Ratings Direct,&nbsp;Visible&nbsp;Alpha&nbsp;and&nbsp;With Intelligence.&nbsp;Platforms will&nbsp;focus on delivering&nbsp;an&nbsp;AI-native
user experience,&nbsp;simplifying&nbsp;and&nbsp;consolidating&nbsp;existing client interfaces, and accelerating the rollout of skills
and applications that make S&amp;P&nbsp;Global&rsquo;s&nbsp;intelligence easier to access,&nbsp;connect&nbsp;and act on.&nbsp;Platforms
will be led by&nbsp;<B>Whit McGraw</B>, in a new role&nbsp;as Head of Platforms.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Enterprise Solutions&nbsp;</B>will&nbsp;continue to&nbsp;be led
by&nbsp;<B>Darren Thomas</B>,&nbsp;who will take on the elevated role of&nbsp;<B>Co-Head of Market Intelligence, Enterprise Solutions</B>.
He will&nbsp;also&nbsp;join&nbsp;the S&amp;P Global Executive Leadership Team.&nbsp;This&nbsp;vertical&nbsp;will deliver solutions that
power critical infrastructure, networks and&nbsp;agentic&nbsp;workflows tied to financial markets, with a&nbsp;focus on the most differentiated
software assets.&nbsp;Pricing and reference data, including consensus pricing and valuation methodologies across public and private markets,
will be part of Enterprise Solutions and&nbsp;leveraged&nbsp;across its end-to-end suite.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;As AI transforms&nbsp;how&nbsp;intelligence is consumed and
acted upon, S&amp;P Global is evolving. In a world where data is abundant, but not all created equal, customers need trusted, connected,
essential intelligence that brings context and conviction to decision-making,&rdquo; said&nbsp;<B>Martina Cheung, President and Chief
Executive Officer, S&amp;P Global</B>. &ldquo;These changes within Market Intelligence align our capabilities, enabling us to elevate
the customer experience while growing our revenue and improving margins.&rdquo;&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">As part of these changes, Market Intelligence&rsquo;s Maritime &amp;
Trade will move to S&amp;P Global Energy, bringing&nbsp;customers&nbsp;comprehensive global supply chain data and signals&nbsp;at a time&nbsp;when&nbsp;trusted
insights are critical to&nbsp;navigating&nbsp;increasing fragmentation and volatility.&nbsp;Similarly, Market Intelligence&rsquo;s Credit
Analytics risk&nbsp;capabilities&nbsp;will move to S&amp;P Global Ratings to better align complementary capabilities and extend&nbsp;S&amp;P
Global Ratings coverage into small and midsized companies.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This new Market Intelligence operating model enhances S&amp;P&nbsp;Global&rsquo;s&nbsp;ability
to deliver essential data, differentiated&nbsp;insights&nbsp;and AI-enabled workflows, while simplifying and&nbsp;consolidating&nbsp;existing&nbsp;customer&nbsp;interfaces.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">In a separate release this morning, the Company has recast previously
reported quarterly segment financial information for 2025 and the first quarter of 2026, to reflect the revised reportable divisions.
The recast financial information by division is accessible&nbsp;on the Company&rsquo;s Investor Relations website under the section titled
 &ldquo;SEC Filings &amp; Reports&rdquo; as well as the section titled &ldquo;Quarterly Earnings &amp; Monthly Metrics.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Separately,&nbsp;<B>Steve Kemps, Chief Legal Officer,</B>&#8239;has
decided to retire from the Company, staying&#8239;until&#8239;December&#8239;31,&#8239;2026,&#8239;to help ensure a smooth transition.
The Company has launched a search for&#8239;his&#8239;successor.&nbsp;Should a successor&nbsp;be appointed prior to Mr. Kemp's departure,
he&#8239;will transition to a special advisor to Ms. Cheung&nbsp;for the&nbsp;remainder&nbsp;of his time with the Company. Mr. Kemps joined
S&amp;P Global in 2016, previously serving as Executive Vice President and General Counsel at Quanta Services. Earlier in his career,
he held in-house legal leadership roles at Hess Retail Corporation, Kimberly-Clark Corporation, and law firm Dorsey &amp; Whitney, and
served as Federal Law Clerk to Judge Paul A. Magnuson of the United States District Court, Minnesota.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;<BR>
 &ldquo;Steve has been a key&#8239;advisor to me, the Board of Directors, and&#8239;members&#8239;of the Executive Leadership Team for
over a decade, providing excellent counsel and stability through periods of transition and transformation. His respect and influence go
well beyond his areas of responsibility and throughout the enterprise. I wish him all the best in his&#8239;next chapter,&rdquo; remarked
Ms. Cheung.&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;<BR>
 &ldquo;Over the past 10 years, I&rsquo;ve had the privilege of working alongside exceptional leaders. My sincerest thanks to Martina and
everyone at S&amp;P Global for the experiences that have shaped my time with the company. I am incredibly proud of what we've accomplished
together, and I look forward to helping ensure a smooth transition,&rdquo; said Mr. Kemps.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>About S&amp;P Global</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global (NYSE: SPGI) enables businesses, governments, and individuals
with trusted data, expertise and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading
benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive in a rapidly changing global
landscape.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">From helping our customers assess new investments across the capital
and commodities markets to navigating the energy expansion, acceleration of artificial intelligence, and evolution of public and private
markets, we enable the world's leading organizations to unlock opportunities, solve challenges, and plan for tomorrow &ndash; today.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

operate in a dynamic business environment in which new risks emerge frequently. Accordingly, the Company cautions readers not to place
undue reliance on any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the dates on which they are made. The Company undertakes no obligation
to update or revise any forward-looking statement to reflect events or circumstances arising after the date on which it is made, except
as required by applicable law. Further information about the Company's businesses, including information about factors that could materially
affect its results of operations and financial condition, is contained in the Company's filings with the SEC, including Item 1A,&nbsp;<I>Risk</I>&nbsp;<I>Factors</I>&nbsp;in
our most recently filed Annual Report on Form 10-K.</P>
